parameters.subject: ={{ $('Get an event').item.json.description.match(/Customer:\s*(.*)/)?.[1] || 'Customer' }} - Pest Control Co Appointment Cancelled
parameters.message:
=

Hi {{ $('Get an event').item.json.description.match(/Customer:\s*(.*)/)?.[1] || 'there' }},

Your Pest Control Co appointment has been cancelled.

Cancelled Appointment: {{ DateTime.fromISO($('Get an event').item.json.start.dateTime).setZone($('Get an event').item.json.start.timeZone).toFormat('cccc, LLLL d, yyyy, h:mm a') }} – {{ DateTime.fromISO($('Get an event').item.json.end.dateTime).setZone($('Get an event').item.json.end.timeZone).toFormat('h:mm a') }}
Service: {{ $('Get an event').item.json.description.match(/Pest Issue:\s*(.*)/)?.[1] || $('Get an event').item.json.summary }}
Address: {{ $('Get an event').item.json.description.match(/Service Address:\s*(.*)/)?.[1] || 'Not provided' }}
Reason: {{ $('Prepare Booking Action Data').item.json.cancellation_reason || 'Not provided' }}

If you would like to book another appointment, please contact us anytime.

Thank you,
Pest Control Co
